seo.title: Memoh — The multi-agent platform
seo.description: Every agent gets its own cloud computer with a desktop, filesystem, and network. Always on, always there.

hero.title: Give your agent a cloud computer
hero.subtitle:
Memoh is a cloud-first multi-agent platform.
Every agent has its own desktop, files, and network, running 24/7.

s1.title: A computer of its own
s1.subtitle: Every agent gets its own desktop, files, and network on a real computer that runs 24/7.

c1.title: Bring your own agent
c1.desc: Deploy your Codex, Claude Code, or other ACP-compatible agents to a Memoh cloud computer. Use your own subscription or models provided by Memoh.

c2.title: Let it work. Take over anytime.
c2.desc: Let it use its desktop to browse websites, search for videos, and operate apps. Follow along anytime, or take over the desktop and continue yourself.

c3.title: Every tool, hosted in one place
c3.desc: Manage dependency packages, app connectors, and agent skills with one click. Everything is hosted on the cloud computer, ready for your agent to use.

c4.title: Build in the cloud. Preview anytime.
c4.desc: Write code and run your development environment entirely on the cloud computer. Open a preview anytime to explore and try out the app as it takes shape.

s2.title: Always on, even when you're not
s2.subtitle: It runs in the cloud. Your laptop sleeps — it doesn't. When something needs your attention, it finds you.

c1.title: Runs on its own
c1.desc: Scheduled tasks and check-ins, no human trigger needed.

c2.title: Reaches out first
c2.desc: When something matters, it messages you first.

c3.title: Picks up where it left off
c3.desc: Sessions don't reset. It continues from last time.
